meta.notes: The tutorial's squad mission: one street through a walled yard, two easy rooms, then a stop for each thing the other side does. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts tut-squad

steps.line: Press [B] on the guard hut door

after.line: They're stacking up on the door

steps.line: Press [F] to send them in

explain.title: Sending them in
explain.text:
Once they're stacked on a door, they'll wait until you say go.
Press [F] and they'll open the door and clear the room.

steps.line: Press [B] on the store door

after.line: They're stacking up on the store door

steps.line: Press [F] to send them in
Follow them in
Those shots came from outside. Get out to the street
He's watching that doorway. Press [B] on the side door

explain.title: An enemy watching a doorway
explain.text:
An enemy who's watching a doorway will shoot anyone who steps into it.
Most rooms have another door, so send the squad to the one behind him.

steps.line: Go around with them
Press [F] to send them in behind him
[X], then press [3] to have them follow you

explain.title: The squad's ring
explain.text:
Tap [B] to give the usual order for whatever you're pointing at.
Hold the same key down to open a ring with the rest of the orders.

steps.line: Go to the end of the wall
There's a gunner ahead. Shoot back to make him duck

explain.title: Suppression
explain.text:
An enemy who's being shot at will keep his head down, and then he can't shoot back.
Shoot at the gunner, then move while he's down.

steps.line: While he's down, run to the blocks
Press [5], then left-click to throw a frag over the sandbags

explain.title: Grenades
explain.text:
Sandbags will stop rifle rounds, but a grenade goes over them.
A grenade hurts you as much as it hurts them, so throw it from cover and not too close.

steps.line: Take the gun nest
Two enemies are waiting inside. Shoot them through the window

explain.title: From outside
explain.text:
Two enemies are waiting on either side of that door for whoever walks in.
You can shoot through a window, and it's often safer to clear a room from outside than to go in.

steps.line: The door is locked. Go around to it
Hold [Space] on the door and choose to kick it in
Walk in
More are coming. Get behind the sandbags
Hold the road gate
They're behind you! [X] on the alley, then press [2]

explain.title: Flanked
explain.text:
While one enemy keeps your attention, the others will walk around behind you.
Don't turn everybody around. Send part of the squad to cover the other way.

steps.line: Finish off the rest of them
